vt.m01.formatAlt: Players split into {groups} groups of {size}. There are {stages} stages, {sec} seconds each.
vt.m01.betweenText: There is a {sec}-second break between stages. It starts early once everyone is ready. After stage {half}, the groups are reshuffled and from stage {next} you work with different people. The frame grows larger as the stages go on.
vt.m01.title: The event
vt.m01.doRotate: Try it: pick a piece and press Rotate
vt.m01.doPlace: Now place that piece inside the frame
vt.m01.doHint: Try it: press Hint (free during the tutorial)
vt.m01.hintOnce: In the real match it costs 2 pieces, once per event

intro.title: Introductions
intro.gatherText: The contestants gather in {place} and form a circle. Once everyone is in place, each person introduces themselves in turn.
intro.doneText: The contestants head off to different parts of the building. Free time until noon. Gather at the 1F Tournament Arena at 12:00.
cer.nextText: In {place}, the contestants stand in a circle and introduce themselves one by one. Free time starts afterwards.
credits.introVoice: Contestants without a recorded introduction are introduced with subtitles only.
